description: Find animated overlays by topic, purpose or platform, most popular first. Each row is one overlay design (its id, name, collections and whether its default is free) with an editor link. Reuse the same filters and pass the returned next_cursor as cursor for another page; a cursor from before a catalog refresh is refused, so start again without one.

free.description: Only overlays whose default is free. Omit for all.

purpose.description: A purpose collection id, such as subscribe or lower-thirds. An unknown id returns the allowed ones.

name: list_overlays
